name: Pipeliners - Image Alt Audit 2026-09-30
body:
> Audit · Pipeliners · 2026-09-30

# Summary
Audit of image alt text across pipelinersusa.com (Sep 30, 2026) comparing the WordPress media library alt, the alt set on each page, and the live alt after OTTO overrides. Includes a rerun after library alt changes.

# Key findings
- 186 attachment rows audited: 78 OK, 56 where OTTO replaced the WordPress alt, 34 empty in WordPress, 11 both, 7 empty on the live page.
- Media library: 343 attachments, 184 used on a live page, 169 with no alt.
- The logo (on about 105 pages) carried a long keyword-stuffed OTTO alt; the hero pipe banner (58 pages) carried an OTTO alt while the library had none.
- 36 alt text drafts for approval: 10 Ready, 24 on hold because the page is ad-touched, 2 skip. One Avondale photo carries a real-estate listing watermark (check usage rights).
- Library changes since the audit: about 69 attachments got new alt or titles (for example "Corroded pipe beside a pipe restored with a smooth red epoxy lining").
- Rerun: 305 page placements still show the OTTO alt instead of the new library alt. Of 81 affected files, 13 are SAFE to clear and 68 sit on ad-touched pages.

# Decisions and status
- OTTO image-alt overrides must be cleared in OTTO for the new library alts to show; ad-touched pages need approval first.

# Files in this folder (rollups only)
- `pipeliners-image-alt-audit-2026-09-30.csv`, `image-alt-by-image.csv`, `image-alt-by-page.csv`, `media-library-all-343.csv`, `library-changes-since-audit.csv`, `alt-text-drafts-for-approval.csv`, `altlist.txt`.
- `rerun/`: AFTER by-page CSV, `otto-override-split.csv`, `still-overridden-by-otto.csv`, `needcheck.txt`.
- Images (`img/`, `big/`), saved page HTML (`live/`), JSON, PHP and Python scripts: not summarized.
